actions.script: const shellData = sri.getShellData() if (shellData != null) ec.web.sendJsonResponse(shellData)

const disallowList = ['apps', 'qapps', 'rest', 'rpc', 'status', 'menuData', 'shellData', 'shellSearch', 'shellCounts', 'userStatus', 'setUserStatus', 'userStatusHeartbeat', 'userStatuses', 'chatTyping', 'chatUnread', 'chatAssistCard', 'richTextImage', 'llm', 'a2a', 'mcp'] let robotsText = "user-agent: *\n" for (const disPath of disallowList) robotsText += `disallow: /${disPath}\n` ec.web.sendTextResponse(robotsText)
